decisions.reason: As a support add-on it likely needs less dedicated investment than the software tools, but because it remained offered across 2018-2019 and complements the firm’s core customer relationships, management would still tend to continue it and explain weak uptake as temporary.

This product had its own page and was still being named in 2019, so the firm has made a visible and likely costly commitment that escalation-of-commitment logic makes management reluctant to reverse quickly.

A standalone compliance-related tool fits the firm’s broader digital service offer and, having been publicly presented on its own page, would be kept unless results were clearly poor enough to outweigh sunk development and reputational commitment.

Because scalable hosting for agencies was highlighted on the home page and appears close to the firm’s strategic direction, management is especially likely to stay committed and defer abandonment in the hope that market traction improves.
